title: Readable not-found errors
items: A not_found answer carries a readable message beside its code ("Request not found", "Endpoint not found", "Attachment not found", "Share link not found", "Connected agent not found", "Google connection not found") on the request, endpoint request list, attachment, share link, connected agent and Google connection routes
The hosted MCP server calls a refusal because something already exists or is in use (HTTP 409) a conflict rather than a validation error
